parameters.name: poNumber
parameters.description: The network's purchase-order number, exactly as the network issued it. Treated as an opaque string: this context never parses it and assumes no format. Only its shape as a URL path segment is checked: 1 to 128 characters, each a letter, a digit, `-`, `.`, `_` or `~`. Anything else is a 400 `invalid-purchase-order-number`.
